name: FinCalc Toolkit – Financial Calculators
author: OnTime Digital

sections.description:
FinCalc Toolkit helps WordPress site owners add useful financial calculators using simple shortcodes. It is built for finance advisors, wealth managers, loan consultants, CA firms, insurance consultants, finance bloggers, and educational websites.

The plugin currently includes:

  • SIP Calculator
  • Step-up SIP Calculator
  • Lumpsum Calculator
  • EMI Calculator
  • FD Calculator
  • RD Calculator
  • CAGR Calculator
  • SWP Calculator
  • Retirement Calculator
  • Goal Planning Calculator
  • Savings Goal Calculator
  • PPF Calculator
  • NPS Calculator
  • EPF Calculator
  • GST Calculator
  • Inflation Calculator
  • Gratuity Calculator
  • Rule of 72 Calculator
  • Simple Interest Calculator
  • Compound Interest Calculator

Core features:

  • Main toolkit shortcode with searchable calculator tabs
  • Individual shortcode for every calculator
  • Mobile responsive design
  • Custom currency symbol
  • Custom primary and accent colors
  • CTA button below calculator results
  • Optional WhatsApp CTA fallback
  • Copy result and print result buttons
  • No external APIs
  • No tracking scripts
  • Browser-side calculations

Shortcodes

Main toolkit:

[fincalc_toolkit]

Optional attributes:

[fincalc_toolkit default="emi" title="Financial Tools" subtitle="Plan smarter with useful calculators." show_hero="yes" show_search="yes"]

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/fincalc-toolkit directory, or install the plugin ZIP through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > FinCalc Toolkit to configure colors, currency, CTA, and display options.
  4. Add [fincalc_toolkit] to any page or post.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal user data. Calculations run in the visitor browser.

Does it use an external API?

No. All calculations are handled locally in the browser.

Can I change the currency symbol?

Yes. You can change the currency symbol from Settings > FinCalc Toolkit.

Can I use only one calculator on a page?

Yes. Use the individual shortcode for the calculator you want to display.

Are the results financial advice?

No. Results are indicative estimates only. Website owners should add suitable disclaimers and professional guidance where needed.
